unsupported: This hub is too old to check and update its version here. Update it once with install.sh on the hub machine, and it will work.
auto_notice: The hub updates itself when idle.
update_footer: The update waits until the assistant and all agents are idle before restarting the hub. If the new version won't start, it rolls back on its own. Connections drop briefly during the restart.
auto_footer: When on, a new version installs itself once the assistant and all agents are idle, then sends a notification.
confirm_body: This won't wait for them to finish: anything waiting on the hub is interrupted (the assistant's current turn, file uploads, terminal connections). Agents in herdr aren't affected and reconnect once the hub is back.
nodes_footer: After the hub updates, your computers keep their personad version unless auto_update_nodes is on in hub.json. To update one, open it and choose Redeploy.
mirror_manager_hint: Choose whose extension downloads to configure. Each assistant keeps its own settings.
mirror_scope: These settings apply only to this assistant and are stored in its database. Leave a field empty to use the original source.
registry_mirror_hint: An HTTPS registry base URL, optionally with a path prefix, such as https://registry.example.com/persona. Not a package or catalog URL.
catalog_mirror_hint: The complete HTTPS URL of the official catalog file, such as https://catalog.example.com/persona-extensions.json. Other markets are not redirected.
mirror_security: The assistant tries the mirror first and falls back to the original source if it fails. Official signatures and package SHA256 digests are still verified. Market tokens are never sent to mirrors.
mirror_invalid: Use an HTTPS URL without credentials, a query or a fragment.
mirror_response_invalid: The assistant returned invalid mirror settings. Retry before making changes.
